# opnsense_bind_record (Data Source)

Records of BIND primary zones (**Services ▸ BIND ▸ Configuration ▸ Records**, plugin `os-bind`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the BIND record.

### Read-Only

- `domain` (String) Select the zone for this record.
- `enabled` (Boolean) This will enable or disable this record.
- `name` (String) Set the name for this record.
- `type` (String) Set the type for this record. One of `A`, `AAAA`, `CAA`, `CNAME`, `DNAME`, `DNSKEY`, `DS`, `HTTPS`, `MX`, `NAPTR`, `NS`, `PTR`, `RP`, `RRSIG`, `SRV`, `SSHFP`, `SVCB`, `TLSA`, `TXT`.
- `value` (String) Set the value for this record.
